conf.description: FireEye FX file-security LEEF notification feed: header split + named key=value attribute decode, derive file.name from filePath's final segment, best-effort devTime parse (no devTimeFormat supplied), keep _raw.

conf.comment: fireeye / fx-alert / syslog-leef. LEEF:1.0 header (Version|Vendor|Product|Version|EventID|) then key=value attrs, delimiter tab or caret. eventType (header field 5) mapped to event.action by analogy with the sibling CEF format's header Name field - not a fields[] row here, flagged in README same as nx-alert's precedent. No severity/action field is documented for LEEF in the work order, so event.severity/event.type are left unmapped on this transport (a gap in the map, not this parser). No fname key on this transport; file.name is always derived from filePath's final segment.

functions.description: split the 5 pipe-delimited LEEF header fields plus the trailing attribute blob (tolerates a leading syslog envelope since unanchored)
tokenize the named-key attribute blob, map every documented key to ECS/custom targets, derive file.name from filePath, best-effort devTime parse, dataset/category tags, cleanup
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
